```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [10, 20, 30],
    "feb": [15, 25, 35],
    "mar": [12, 22, 32],
}))

long_df = df.unpivot(
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    index=["id"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales",
)

print(long_df.to_native())
```
